items.title: Goldman raises global data center capacity forecast to 273 GW by 2030
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs raised its forecast for global data center capacity to 273 gigawatts by 2030 from 217 gigawatts previously, citing stronger artificial intelligence infrastructure demand and expectations for further project announcements.

items.title: Supreme Court to Hear Goldman Sachs’ Bankruptcy Arbitration Bid
items.summary: The US Supreme Court agreed to review a request by Goldman Sachs on whether bankruptcy courts can override arbitration agreements, setting up a high-stakes test of the Federal Arbitration Act’s reach.
